import os
import re
import subprocess

def check_disk_usage_warning(path, threshold_percentage):
    try:
        # Run the df -h command and capture the output
        result = subprocess.run(['df', '-h', path], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        df_output = result.stdout

        # Regular expression to parse the df -h output
        pattern = re.compile(r'^\S+\s+\S+\s+(\d+)%\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+' + re.escape(path) + r'$', re.MULTILINE)

        # Search for the matching line
        match = pattern.search(df_output)
        if match:
            usage_percentage = int(match.group(1))
            return usage_percentage > threshold_percentage, df_output
        else:
            return False, df_output
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        return False, ""
